name: Accenture
title: 8-K · NEWS RELEASE OF ACCENTURE, DATED MARCH 19, 2026

read.thesis: Record Q2 bookings of $22.1B and FY26 FCF raised to $10.8–11.5B, but local-currency revenue growth guided to 3–5% and bookings grew only 1% in local currency, so demand evidence is mixed.

triggers.label: FY26 FCF raised to $10.8–11.5B
triggers.quote: Raises full-year free cash flow expectation to be in the range of $10.8 billion to $11.5 billion

triggers.label: Local-currency bookings +1%
triggers.quote: an increase of 6% in U.S. dollars and 1% in local currency

triggers.label: FY26 LC revenue growth 3–5% (from 2–5%)
triggers.quote: Company now expects full-year revenue growth to be 3% to 5% in local currency

guidance.quote: Company now expects full-year revenue growth to be 3% to 5% in local currency
Now expects full-year GAAP diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $13.25 to $13.50
now expects full-year adjusted earnings per share to be in the range of $13.65 to $13.90
Raises full-year free cash flow expectation to be in the range of $10.8 billion to $11.5 billion
Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Outlook $18.35B – $19.0B Revenue Growth (Local Currency) 1% – 5%

red_flags.label: Local-currency bookings only +1%
red_flags.quote: an increase of 6% in U.S. dollars and 1% in local currency

red_flags.label: Effective tax rate up to 24.3% from 20.4%
red_flags.quote: The company's effective tax rate for the quarter was 24.3%, compared with 20.4%
